127594: Natsuo is introduced as a second-year high school student who loves writing novels, so he frequently heads to the rooftop during his lunch breaks to develop his passion. It is there that he meets the rookie English teacher named Hina Tachibana, who becomes his first crush.
127595: She is the elder sister of Rui Tachibana, but soon after Tsukiko Tachibana (Hina's divorced mother) marries a widower named Akihito Fujii, Hina becomes the stepsister of Natsuo Fujii.
127596: Rui is the younger sister of Hina Tachibana, but soon after Tsukiko Tachibana (Rui's divorced mother) marries a widower named Akihito Fujii, Rui becomes Natsuo Fujii's step-sister. At first glance, Rui is an aloof and blunt girl who is hard to read emotionally.
135346: Shuu Hagiwara is a teacher and the ex-boyfriend of Hina Tachibana due to fact that Shuu is married, therefore his relationship with Hina for the last two years is an illicit affair and he also seems to have a good friendship with Reiji Kiriya.
135347: Tsukiko Tachibana is the mother of Hina and Rui Tachibana who began to date Akihito Fujii after Jou Mikimoto (Tsukiko's ex-husband) left her for another woman. Tsukiko becomes the stepmother of Natsuo Fujii after she got married to Akihito.
135348: She is a member of the Literature Club and a friend of Rui Tachibana.
135349: Fumiya Kurimoto is Natsuo's best friend and confidant. He is a waiter at L'Amant along with Masaki Kobayashi and Ayano. Kurimoto lives in an apartment with his mother and younger sister.
135351: (at the beginning) Miu Ashihara is the former president of the Literature Club. _Appearance:_ Miu has dark green hair that is styled in a bobcut with her bangs covers much of her forehead and olive green eyes.
135352: Akihito Fujii is the father of Natsuo Fujii. He began to date Tsukiko Tachibana, after Akihito's wife died and he becomes the stepfather of Hina Tachibana and Rui Tachibana after remarrying Tsukiko.
135462: Reiji Kiriya is a professional author and teacher who publishes under the pen name of You Hasukawa. He teaches Modern Japanese at Natsuo Fujii's high school and the monitor of the Literature Club.
135548: Masaki Kobayashi is the owner of L'Amant (French for 'The Lover') restaurant and a former Yakuza. He's an openly gay man and prefers to be addressed as Marie, though he is often addressed as The Master or Mari-san by others. His coworkers are Fumiya Kurimoto and Ayano.
137186: He is an American high school student and a member of the literature club. He is a bit careless and laid back.
203984: Youta's mother. She is a waitress at L'Amant along with Masaki Kobayashi and Fumiya Kurimoto.
257476: Ayano's son. He likes to eat a lot of candies.
